record.original_question: For chromatic-polynomial zeros of graphs with maximum degree Delta, what is the optimal sharp bound C_opt(Delta) on their modulus, and what can be proved about zero-free or root-location regions in the complex q-plane beyond discs centered at q=0?

evidence.quote: Question 3.4 (a) What is the sharp bound Copt(Delta)? Might 2Delta work? Is Copt(3) = 3? What about regions of the q-plane other than discs centered at q = 0?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let G be a finite simple graph with maximum degree Δ, and let P(G,q) denote its chromatic polynomial, i.e. the unique polynomial in q whose value at every positive integer k equals the number of proper k-colorings of G. It is known that there exists an absolute constant C(Δ), depending only on Δ, such that every complex root q of P(G,q) satisfies |q| ≤ C(Δ)·... more precisely, results of Sokal and others establish that |q| ≤ C·Δ for some absolute constant C (with current upper bounds C ≤ 6.91, and lower bounds of the form C ≥ some value > 1) for every graph of maximum degree Δ.

Define
   C_opt(Δ) = sup { |q| : q ∈ ℂ is a root of P(G,q) for some graph G with maximum degree at most Δ }.

(a) Determine the exact value of C_opt(Δ) for each integer Δ ≥ 2. In particular:
   (i) Is it true that C_opt(Δ) ≤ 2Δ for all Δ?
   (ii) Is C_opt(3) = 3?

(b) Beyond closed discs {q ∈ ℂ : |q| ≤ R} centered at q = 0, characterize the regions of the complex q-plane that are zero-free for the chromatic polynomials of all graphs of maximum degree at most Δ. That is, determine (or describe meaningfully) the complement in ℂ of the closure of the set of chromatic roots of all such graphs.
artifact.status_search_result: The sharp constant in the bound |q| ≤ C·Δ for chromatic roots of graphs of maximum degree Δ remains open. Sokal originally proved C ≤ 7.963907; this was successively improved (Borgs; Fernández–Procacci to C ≤ 6.91; Jackson–Procacci–Sokal and later work giving further refinements), and for real roots Dong–Koh obtained C ≤ 5.67. No matching lower bound is known, so neither the conjectures C_opt(Δ) ≤ 2Δ nor C_opt(3) = 3 have been resolved. The characterization of zero-free regions beyond discs centered at 0 also remains an active research area.

status_evidence.title: Absence of Zeros for the Chromatic Polynomial on Bounded Degree Graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Fernández–Procacci type improvement of Sokal's bound to C ≤ 6.91
status_evidence.claim: Improvements to Sokal's bound continue; sharp value unknown.

status_evidence.title: Linear Bound in Terms of Maxmaxflow for the Chromatic Roots of Series-Parallel Graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Royle and Sokal: chromatic roots of series-parallel graphs in terms of maxmaxflow
status_evidence.claim: Active research on chromatic root locations; sharp constants not determined.
